art.title: Saint John the Baptist
art.why: John points away from himself, holding a scroll that reads 'ECCE AGNUS DEI': John 1:36, the words that send Andrew and the other disciple after Jesus. The Duccio Calling is used, and the NGA has no other calling of the apostles.

art.title: The Philosopher
art.why: REUSE of an existing art id: the only NGA philosopher in thought. It is already used for 'athens' and the peterson-harris debate.

art.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
art.why: REUSE of an existing art id: the exact subject and the only NGA Conversion of Paul (used for St Stephen's day).

art.title: Saint Peter
art.artist: Studio of Sir Peter Paul Rubens
art.why: An old Peter holding the keys, eyes turned upward: the man who said 'to whom would we go?'

art.title: Interior of the Pantheon, Rome
art.why: Ordinary people wander, talk, look up and kneel in a great church open to the sky: the one visit the practice invites. It is daytime, not evening. That the Pantheon has been a church since 609 is outside knowledge and should be cited.

music.why: An old Irish prayer for one thing only, the heart's best answer: Peter's 'to whom would we go?' as a hymn.
'Fast falls the eventide': the evening hymn of the whole app, for the last session.

memory.title: Come, and see
memory.source: WEB: 'He said to them, “Come, and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.' https://ebible.org/eng-web/JHN01.htm

memory.title: To whom would we go?
memory.source: WEB: 'Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.' (the WEB's closing quotation mark comes after verse 69) https://ebible.org/eng-web/JHN06.htm
